NIFTY 50 - V1 (2R target + Chikou exit) - bias ON

Rules: 1h Ichimoku (9/26/52/26). Entry needs all four: (1) close beyond the cloud, (2) future cloud colour agrees, (3) Tenkan/Kijun side agrees, (4) Chikou (close plotted 26 bars back) beyond the cloud at that position. Stop = cloud edge at entry. V1 exits at a 2x-risk target, the stop, or a Chikou cross. Execution on 1-minute data at the open after the signal bar closes.
Bias: previous day candle colour AND previous completed 4h session candle colour. Both green = longs only; both red = shorts only; otherwise no trade.
